name: dsh-desktop
author: DSH Desktop contributors
description: Desktop shell for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI: window, attach-or-spawn, Host bar, hide-to-bar, quit-kills-host.

scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && node scripts/assert-package-inputs.js && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/assert-package-inputs.js && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build && node scripts/assert-package-inputs.js && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
